localChanges: Hovering over or tabbing to one of the round buttons beside the map and in the top bar, such as End turn, now shows what it does and its key in the game's own tooltip, and screen readers read the same name.
With reduced motion turned on in your system, End turn glows steadily instead of pulsing.
With the slate look (?theme=slate), the round buttons ease between states and give a little when pressed (closes #703).
